label: Contested review sufficiency
initiation: A merge prompts a challenge to feedback handling and the number of ACKs.
outcome: The author gives a scoped sufficiency rationale; later discussion proposes a follow-up explanation.
alternative_explanation: An individual justification may coexist with broader flexible practice, not a fixed shared threshold.
level_rationale: Explanation of this application; collective-choice clarification is an alternative, not an established new rule.
